registration: OSM way 371741580 fixes the corner, Lord Street line and 22.9m frontage; small obliquity simplified to project axes. That way's 28.94m London Street depth also covers the adjoining mock-Tudor building: Google's map outline (18.7m), Google satellite parapet (19.6m) and a near-frontal May2011 Street View scaled from the camera geometry (19.3-20.4m) give a 19.5m return. Heights, projections and individual bay sizes visually calibrated, not surveyed.
evidence: Unobstructed Commons front and London Street photographs September2021, wider oblique Commons image and user-supplied Street View tracks. Sculptural carving is interpreted geometry, not a scan; hidden rear/party elevations remain estimated.

roof_ranges.evidence: Close Google satellite aerial inspected2026-10-22: broader London Street hip, narrower Lord Street range, short corner saddle. Widths/pitches are visually calibrated estimates, not measured or surveyed.

london_elevation: Bay, tower, gable and opening positions measured as fractions of the return in the near-frontal May2011 Street View (pano UobTWVKYCf-YxcK1OBgnNA, heading 46): corner arch .15, towers .24/.45, niche bay .35, arched bays .55/.72/.90. Arches about 1.45m and upper lights about 1.6m wide; the gable spans the two towers. Heights unchanged.
